title: Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File Information Disclosure Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the generation of log files. The issue results from including sensitive information in a log file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
addtionnal_details:
Phoenix Contact has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://certvde.com/en/advisories/VDE-2026-060
timeline:
